data.name: Mahbub
data.gender_notes: Mahbub is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is loved and cherished by Allah. Refers to the attribute of Allah being the most beloved and cherished. The name Mahbub carries the meaning “Loved, Cherished” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahbub usually hope their child will grow to embody loved, cherished and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who is beloved and cherished by Allah, reflecting the concept of Tawhid.
data.etymology: Mahbub belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loved, Cherished.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahbub total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: محبوب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم محبوب يعني الحبيب والمحبوب بشدة من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم محبوب مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ح-ب-ب' والذي يعني الحب والوداد. يعتبر محبوب من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الحب الإلهي والمحبة الربانية. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَحَبًّا مِّنَ اللّهِ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ' (آل عمران: 144). يشير إلى الشخص الذي يحبه الله تعالى والمحبوب لديه

in_urdu.name: محبوب
in_urdu.meaning: محبوب کا مطلب ہے پیارا، اللہ کا حبیب، محبوب
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام محبوب عربی جڑ 'ح-ب-ب' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے محبت، پیار۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بڑی اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ الہی محبت اور پیار کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، اس نام کے حامل افراد کو اللہ کی خاص کرسومات حاصل ہوتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: महबूब
in_hindi.meaning: महबूब का अर्थ है प्रियतम, ईश्वर का प्रिय
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम महबूब अरबी जड़ 'ح-ب-ب' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रेम, प्रिय। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह ईश्वरीय प्रेम और स्नेह को दर्शाता है। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों को संबोधित करता है जो ईश्वर के अत्यंत प्रिय होते हैं

in_pashto.name: محبوب
in_pashto.meaning: محبوب د معنا دا دی چی مینه ور، د الله ګران
in_pashto.long_meaning: د محبوب نوم د عربي ريښو 'ح-ب-ب' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د مينې او مینه ور معنا لري. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د الهي مينې او محبت د څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چې د الله تعالی نزدې محبوب دي

in_english.name: Mahbub
in_english.meaning: Mahbub means beloved, one who is loved by God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mahbub is derived from the Arabic root 'ح-ب-ب' (ḥ-b-b), which means love, beloved. It appears several times in the Quran, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. Mahbub signifies a person who is immensely loved by God, reflecting divine affection and benevolence. Historically, this name has been cherished across Muslim cultures for its spiritual connotations and positive personality traits associated with it, such as compassion, kindness, and piety

In many Islamic societies, the name Mahbub is given to children as a reminder of their relationship with Allah. It is also used to address individuals who are known for their piety and dedication to Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mahbub carries a deep spiritual significance as it refers to the attribute of Allah being the most beloved and cherished. For Muslims, striving to be closer to Allah and embodying His attributes is a fundamental aspect of their faith. The name Mahbub serves as a constant reminder of this spiritual goal. It instills a sense of love, humility, and devotion towards Allah, motivating individuals to live their lives in accordance with His teachings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Loved, Cherished" symbolizes One who is loved and cherished by Allah. Refers to the attribute of Allah being the most beloved and cherished.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mahbub serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of loved, cherished.
